summary: A text input that filters a list as you type, in three sizes, three shapes and three shadows, with an optional icon and a loading state.

props.name: items
props.description: What to search. `label` is matched and shown; `description` and `avatar` are optional. The shape is fixed rather than generic because you own the file: data that does not fit is an edit to the item body, not an API.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label above the input. Leave it out and the input is described by its placeholder alone.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the input, for what the field expects rather than a restatement of the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and width of the input. The popup matches it, or it reads as a different control.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius, applied to the input and the popup together. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the input. `inset` reads as a well, `outset` as a raised control.

props.name: icon
props.description: Any icon. It is positioned over the input and the text is padded around it, so pass the glyph and nothing else.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the field.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the results with a loading row, for an async source. The fetching itself is yours; this is only the state.

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Highlights the first match as you type, so Enter takes it without an arrow key first.

props.name: limit
props.description: Cap on how many matches are listed. `0` lists them all.

props.name: animate
props.description: Fades the popup in and out. Turn it off for a static popup, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of the parent instead of `size`'s fixed width, for an input inside a form column that isn't a fixed size itself - a dialog, say.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the input's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them. Use `size` for the dimensions.
